title: Toon-Shaded 3D Character Turnaround
summary: A modelling-ready character concept sheet for a toon-shaded 3D game: front, three-quarter and back views in a relaxed A-pose with cel shading, clean outlines, consistent proportions and a palette swatch row. Slots for character, role, silhouette motif and palette.
prompt:
A character turnaround concept sheet for a stylised toon-shaded 3D game, ready to hand to a 3D modeller.

Character: {argument name="character" default="a young sky-courier with oversized goggles, a patched flight jacket and a mail satchel full of glowing letters"}.
Gameplay role: {argument name="role" default="agile traversal hero who glides and grapples"}.
Silhouette motif: {argument name="silhouette_motif" default="a long scarf and swept-back wing-like jacket tails"} that make the character recognisable from any angle.

# Sheet layout
- Three full-body views side by side on a plain light-grey background: front, three-quarter front, and back.
- Relaxed A-pose, arms about 30 degrees from the body, feet shoulder-width apart, neutral expression.
- All three views share an identical height, eye line, shoulder line and foot line, aligned to faint horizontal guide lines.
- Below the figures, a single row of 6 flat colour swatches taken from the design. No written labels.

# Rendering style
- Cel shading with exactly two tones per material (lit and shadow), a hard shadow edge, and a thin rim highlight.
- Clean, even-weight dark outlines like an inverted-hull outline shader.
- Large, readable shapes and colour blocks; small details kept to a few deliberate accents so the model reads well at gameplay camera distance.
- Proportions: {argument name="proportions" default="slightly stylised, about 6 heads tall, large hands and boots"}.

# Palette
{argument name="palette" default="faded navy and mustard yellow with an off-white scarf and a teal glow accent"}. Each material has its own distinct hue so it maps cleanly to texture regions.

# Avoid
Dynamic action poses, perspective distortion, mismatched details between views, soft painterly rendering, photoreal skin, busy backgrounds, text labels, watermarks, and any resemblance to existing franchise characters.
